list.name: contratista
list.label: Contratista
list.query: SELECT id as __value, razon_social as __text FROM contratistas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY razon_social

list.name: area
list.label: Área
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM areas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

list.name: proceso
list.label: Proceso
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM procesos WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR area_id IN (${area:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

list.name: usuario
list.label: Usuario
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre_completo as __text FROM usuarios_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY nombre_completo

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', fecha) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_events WHERE accion = 'REJECT' AND (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ep.nombre AS etapa, COUNT(*) AS rechazos FROM historial_etapas h JOIN expedientes e ON h.expediente_id = e.id JOIN etapas_proceso ep ON h.etapa_id = ep.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE h.accion = 'rechazar' AND e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) GROUP BY ep.nombre ORDER BY rechazos DESC
SELECT usuario_nombre, COUNT(*) AS rechazos FROM audit_events WHERE accion = 'REJECT' AND (0 IN (${usuario:csv}) OR usuario_id IN (${usuario:csv})) GROUP BY usuario_nombre ORDER BY rechazos DESC

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h.accion = 'rechazar')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) AS tasa_rechazo FROM historial_etapas h JOIN expedientes e ON h.expediente_id = e.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv}))
